evidence.claim: Eight seats that copy one configuration (vendor, model, system prompt, tools, context), including tool-order permutations and distinct seat_id/name/role labels, audit to effective_independence_count=1 with one flagged cluster of size 8. Measured 1.

On the same cloned roster, independently authored identical first-round texts yield mean pairwise token-Jaccard 1.0, corroboration=CORROBORATED. Outputs were not derived from the fingerprint function.
An 8-seat roster with distinct vendor/model/prompt/tools/context reports independence 8 (must be >1 so the detector is not constant-firing) and mean Jaccard 0.059992.

negative_controls.description: A genuinely diverse 8-seat roster must report independence >1. Silence here would make the eight-copies result indistinguishable from a detector that always emits 1.
Renaming a cloned seat must not mint a second voice.

report.falsifiable_answer: Yes: 8 copies of one configuration report effective independence 1.

residual_unknowns.claim: First-round texts used for corroboration are scripted fixtures, not live model completions. A live 8-clone council could still diverge in sampling even when configs match.
residual_unknowns.settling_experiment: Seat eight live copies of one config, capture first-round bytes, re-run similarity_report, and require corroboration.agrees.

residual_unknowns.claim: Sampling parameters (temperature, seed, top_p) are not in the five catalog fingerprint fields, so two seats that differ only in temperature still count as one voice.
residual_unknowns.settling_experiment: If later spec text names sampling as voice-defining, add it to FINGERPRINT_FIELDS with a regression on this unit's eight-copy fixture.

reviewer.notes: Probe 2 re-measures eight copies, rejects a seat-count detector, rejects a constant-1 detector, and requires each of the five fingerprint fields to split a voice. A second human in a fresh context was not obtained on this worktree.
